purpose: Short, non-blocking feedback over the page (saved, copied, undone) that closes itself when its time bar runs out. A critical toast stays until it is closed.

notFor.case: A persistent notice about the product or the page.
A decision the person must make.

Open.meaning: Put in the queue with showToast.
Open.visual: Enters on toast-enter: it fades in while it rises, and the icon lands a beat later. Colours by Appearance × Variant; e.g. filled: Surface/layer-2 with a Border/default stroke, title Content/primary, description Content/secondary, icon Content/accent (default), Content/secondary (secondary) or the status content role such as Status/success/content; the bar empties over the countdown.

Paused.meaning: Hover or focus on the toast, a swipe, or a hidden page.

Closed.meaning: The bar ran out (4 s for one line, 6 s with a description, 10 s with an action) or the person pressed close.

a11y.role: status (polite live region); alert for critical
a11y.keyboard: Alt+T moves focus to the toast region (sonner hotkey); focus pauses the timer.
a11y.reducedMotion: It fades instead of moving; the time bar keeps running because it is information (toast-countdown keeps use-countdown).
notes: Severity is carried by the icon and the text, never colour alone.
An action such as Undo needs a second way to be reached, because the toast times out.
A critical toast never closes by itself.

openQuestions: The close button stays ghost with the default ink on every appearance, solid included (toast-contract.md). Intended, or should it take the solid ink?
